verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a plain C/C++ runtime driven from the command line (`llama cli`, `llama serve`), with a server component, Docker images and pre-built binaries, so it runs headlessly on servers. The web UI is optional and sits on top of the server. Community users confirm running it from the terminal, e.g. `llama-mtmd-cli` chat sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of CI-pipeline usage, and detailed first-party docs on headless server deployment beyond README headings.
